blocks.text: מִי כָמוֹךָ אַב הָרַחֲמִים. זוֹכֵר יְצוּרָיו לַחַיִּים בְּרַחֲמִים. וְנֶאֱמָן אַתָּה לְהַחֲיוֹת מֵתִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ מְחַיֵּה הַמֵּתִים:

אַף אֹרַח מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְיָ קִוִּינוּךָ. תַּאֲוַת לֵב בַּצַּר פְּקַדְנוּךָ. בָּרֵי לֵבָב מֵאֶתְמוֹל קִדַּמְנוּךָ. שׁוֹפַר תְּרוּעָה טֶרֶם שִׁמַּעֲנוּךָ: גְּזֵרָה חַקֹּתָ מִיצִירַת בְּרֵאשִׁית. רֹאשׁ דְּבָרְךָ תְּשׁוּבָה לְהָשִׁית. דִּין טֶרֶם הֶעֱרַךְ מֵרֵאשִׁית. קָדְמָה לְמַלֵּט שׁוֹבָבִים מֵחֲרִישִׁית: הַיּוֹצֵר יַחַד שְׁנֵי לְבָבֵיהֶם. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט סַרְעַף קִרְבֵיהֶם. וְאִם אָוֶן נִרְאָה בְּמַחֲבוֹאֵיהֶם. פָּקוֹד תִּפְקוֹד לָמוֹ קְרוֹבֵיהֶם: זְכֹר הֲסָרַת שֶׁכֶם מִסֵּבֶל. עֶבֶד כְּהָחְפַּשׁ מֵעִנּוּי כֶּבֶל. חֲנִיטָיו אִם תְּעַתְעוּ בְּתֵבֵל. שִׂיחוֹ יְחוֹנְנֵם לְחַיֵּי הֶבֶל: טְמִינַת לֵב וְנִקְמַת קֵץ. נִדָּחִים לֶאֱסוֹף בּוֹ בְּקֵץ. יוֹם מוּכָן עִתִּים לְהָקֵץ. מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה וּמִקֵּץ לְקֵץ: כַּסֵּא לְהַקְפּוֹרַת חֹדֶשׁ לִקּוֹב. כְּסוּחִים בְּלַהֲטוֹ לְהַבְהֵב לִרְקוֹב.
Who is like Thee, Father of compassion who remembers His creatures for life in compassion; and Thou art faithful to revive the dead. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who revives the dead.

Even on the path of Thy judgments, O Lord, we trust in Thee; O Thou, longing of our heart, in adversity we search for Thee; pure of heart, we appeared already yesterday before Thee, even before sounding the tone of the Shofar. By decree didst Thou decide from the original creation to appoint repentance as the first of Thy pronouncements; even before the first judgment was arranged, repentance was already there to save sinners from destruction. Thou who hast formed their two instincts together and seest and knowest their innermost thoughts, should a sin appear within their hiding places, Thou wilt surely bear their great ancestors in mind for them. Remember him (Joseph) whose shoulder Thou didst relieve from the burden, who as a slave, was freed from the affliction of fetters; though his offsprings have erred through lust, may his purity save them in this life of vanity. As for the day hidden in Thy heart and the retribution at the end of days, bring about the gathering of the exiles, the day prepared for the end of seasons, that is awaited from year to year, from time to time. Reveal the hidden day, decide the month for the severed thorns (sinners) to be burnt and disappear, for the stumbling block to be removed from the crooked heart and for Abraham, Isaac and Jacob to be remembered.
The Lord will reign for ever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
And Thou, O Holy One, art enthroned above the songs of praise of Israel, O God.
לְהָסִיר מִכְשׁוֹל מִלֵּב הֶעָקוֹב. לְהִזָּכֵר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיַעֲקֹב:
יִמְלֹךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:
וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵל נָא:
